declared_transformations.description: A dump source_name equal to an OP serialized identity remains that canonical prefix.
A name declared by addIdenticalNames belongs to that OP canonical prefix.
An OP field assigned directly to another OP field is a source variant of the target serialized identity.
If an addIdenticalNames member is also its own OP canonical serialized identity, the direct canonical declaration owns the dump row.
A normalized dump member not declared as an OP identity, identical-name alias, or field variant is retained in the exclusion ledger.
Mappings declared by tools/gt6_prefix_mapping.json connect OP identities to current CrucibleCraft prefixes.
blockGem and blockIngot intentionally map to the one CrucibleCraft block form.
pipeMedium/pipeLarge/pipeHuge each project to distinct fluid and item runtime forms.
The eight selected T8 fluid/item pipe forms map to pipeTiny/Small/Medium/Large/Huge.
T10 adds double, triple, and hot ingot runtime forms.
